artifacts.content:
# Impact Graph Recovery

Outcome: pass

Reproduced one failure in `validateGraph reports closed deterministic structural, reference, and cycle errors`: top-level unknown-key errors were accumulated, then canonical validation returned success and left `errors` undefined.

Changed only `examples/impact-planner/src/graph.js`: `validateGraph` now returns the accumulated exact-key errors when `errors.length > 0` before canonical validation.

The Windows `apply_patch` helper failed with its sandbox setup error. The contract-required SHA-guarded PowerShell replacement then completed after elevated filesystem access. Diff verification confirmed exactly one new guard, no original guard remaining, and restoration of that line recreates the original graph SHA-256 `4b0b88f4b4620e72ac102c36867fd90a3eb71086b4140360774f02698984b091`.

`examples/impact-planner/test/graph.test.mjs` remained byte-preserved with SHA-256 `0bf8b1dba85db54db618026b42b25d9e191289f99db0ab21975961f1986823bc`; the unknown-key assertion was not changed.

Verification: `node --test examples/impact-planner/test/graph.test.mjs` passed 6 tests, failed 0.
